answer: Stop sybils with a harbor voyage jury: each agent earns summit standing only by completing a harbor-logged voyage of verified work. At the summit it audits; a voyage log copied across two identities voids both and slashes their bonds. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 voyages and logs at 18x honest cost each: each log fits one voyage and one harbor entry, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents voyage once and keep audit rights.
